repo_prior_art.cite: panel_ppml_forbidden_comparison: PPML forbidden-comparison frontier concerns pseudo-true coefficient signs, not exact Poisson minimax intervals.

published_prior_art.cite: EvansHansenStark2005 gives general expected-measure minimax duality; KabailaByrne2001 is scalar Poisson.
Kabaila2013Randomized treats scalar binomial atom splitting, not the multivariate nuisance-uniform minimax gap.
MoreauKastler2025 supplies the proportional target but no exact all-untreated-zero minimax penalty.
KabailaByrne2001 is an ordered scalar-Poisson interval result, not a staggered causal-ratio zero-atom bound.
SchaferStark2009 approximates compact-parameter MES procedures by finite-prior Monte Carlo games, not this truncation-plus-integrality reduction.
SchaferStark2009 gives Monte Carlo approximation and off-support risk control; AndrewsChengGuggenberger2020 gives asymptotic drifting-sequence uniformity, not a finite exact verifier.
Martin2017 and Wooldridge2023 concern different regular fixed-T panel estimands and do not state this aggregate-Poisson efficient coefficient.
BrownCarterLowZhang2004 proves Poisson-process/white-noise equivalence, not connected-interval minimax-length convergence after this nuisance projection.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: experiment class and all theorem targets
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Claims are conditional on the maintained bounded aggregate product-Poisson experiment, including calibrated known intensity; estimation of an unknown intensity is excluded.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: All exact-frontier, certificate, and Gaussian-bridge claims are for the stated known-κ, bounded-exposure/time/effect class only.
